title: SpecialistAuditResult
description: Payload returned by modular specialist audit tools (inspect_robots_and_rendering, inspect_structured_data, inspect_aeo_quotability, inspect_freshness_trust, inspect_on_site_retention) when invoked individually via MCP or Python API.

site.description: The target domain or URL audited.

tool.description: The specific specialist tool identifier executed.

error.description: Optional error description if execution was prevented (e.g. SSRF blocked or fetch failure).

total_findings.description: Total count of findings detected by this specialist tool.
